# Contract: Service Interfaces

**Feature**: `001-document-upload-management` | Layer: `ContosoDashboard/Services/` (Constitution III)

All methods take the requesting user's id and enforce authorization internally ([research.md](../research.md) R7). Denied or missing resources return `null` / `false` / an empty list / a failed result — never an exception that reveals existence.

## IFileStorageService (infrastructure abstraction — Constitution I)

```csharp
public interface IFileStorageService
{
    // storagePath is relative, generated by the caller, forward-slash separated.
    Task UploadAsync(Stream content, string storagePath, string contentType, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<Stream> DownloadAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken ct = default);   // throws FileNotFoundException if missing
    Task DeleteAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken ct = default);             // no-op if missing
}
```

- Implementations: `LocalFileStorageService` (training, `System.IO`, root `FileStorage:RootPath`); future `AzureBlobStorageService` (same `storagePath` as blob name).
- Local implementation MUST reject any resolved path outside the root.

## IMalwareScanner (infrastructure abstraction — FR-007)

```csharp
public interface IMalwareScanner
{
    Task<ScanResult> ScanAsync(Stream content, string fileExtension, CancellationToken ct = default); // resets stream position
}
public sealed record ScanResult(bool IsClean, string? Reason);
```

- Training implementation: `LocalMalwareScanner` (signature/content check + EICAR detection, R6).

## IDocumentService

```csharp
public interface IDocumentService
{
    // Upload (FR-001..FR-010, FR-031)
    Task<DocumentUploadResult> UploadAsync(DocumentUploadRequest request, Stream content, int requestingUserId);

    // Queries (FR-011..FR-015, FR-013, FR-030)
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> GetMyDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> GetSharedWithMeAsync(int requestingUserId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> SearchAsync(int requestingUserId, string term, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> GetProjectDocumentsAsync(int projectId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> GetTaskDocumentsAsync(int taskId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<List<DocumentListItem>> GetRecentDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, int count = 5);
    Task<DocumentDetails?> GetDocumentAsync(int documentId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<List<Project>> GetUploadableProjectsAsync(int requestingUserId);   // FR-008

    // File access (FR-016, FR-017, FR-032) — logs Preview/Download
    Task<DocumentFileResult?> OpenFileAsync(int documentId, int requestingUserId, bool preview);

    // Management (FR-018..FR-021, FR-025, FR-026)
    Task<OperationResult> UpdateMetadataAsync(int documentId, DocumentMetadataUpdate update, int requestingUserId);
    Task<OperationResult> ReplaceFileAsync(int documentId, string originalFileName, long sizeBytes, Stream content, int requestingUserId);
    Task<OperationResult> DeleteAsync(int documentId, int requestingUserId);

    // Sharing (FR-022, FR-022a) — uploader only
    Task<OperationResult> ShareWithUserAsync(int documentId, int recipientUserId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<OperationResult> ShareWithDepartmentAsync(int documentId, string department, int requestingUserId);
    Task<OperationResult> RevokeShareAsync(int documentShareId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<List<DocumentShareItem>> GetSharesAsync(int documentId, int requestingUserId);

    // Task integration (FR-028, FR-029)
    Task<OperationResult> AttachToTaskAsync(int documentId, int taskId, int requestingUserId);
    Task<OperationResult> DetachFromTaskAsync(int documentId, int taskId, int requestingUserId);

    // Dashboard (FR-030)
    Task<int> GetMyDocumentCountAsync(int requestingUserId);
}
```

### DTOs (service boundary)

| Type | Fields |
|---|---|
| `DocumentUploadRequest` | Title, Description?, Category, ProjectId?, TaskId?, Tags (list), OriginalFileName, SizeBytes |
| `DocumentUploadResult` | Succeeded, DocumentId?, ErrorMessage? |
| `DocumentQuery` | Category?, ProjectId?, FromDate?, ToDate?, SortBy (Title \| UploadedDate \| Category \| FileSize), SortDescending |
| `DocumentListItem` | DocumentId, Title, Category, UploadedDate, FileSizeBytes, FileType, ProjectId?, ProjectName?, UploadedByName, Tags, CanPreview, CanManage, CanShare |
| `DocumentDetails` | `DocumentListItem` + Description, OriginalFileName, LastModifiedDate |
| `DocumentMetadataUpdate` | Title, Description?, Category, Tags |
| `DocumentFileResult` | Content (Stream), ContentType, DownloadFileName, Inline (bool) |
| `DocumentShareItem` | DocumentShareId, RecipientDisplay (user name or department), SharedDate |
| `OperationResult` | Succeeded, ErrorMessage? (generic "not found or not permitted" on denial) |

### Behavioral guarantees

- Validation order for upload/replace: size (0 < size ≤ 25 MB) → extension allow-list → `IMalwareScanner` → path generation → storage write → DB save ([research.md](../research.md) R4).
- `UploadAsync` with `TaskId` attaches the document and inherits the task's project (FR-029).
- Every successful mutation and every file open writes a `DocumentActivity` row; scan rejections write `ScanRejected`.
- Notifications: share → each recipient (department share: all users in department except uploader); project upload → all project members + PM except uploader.

## IDocumentReportService (Administrator only — FR-033)

```csharp
public interface IDocumentReportService
{
    Task<DocumentReport?> GetReportAsync(DateTime fromUtc, DateTime toUtc, int requestingUserId); // null if not Administrator
}
```

`DocumentReport`: `UploadsByFileType` (FileType, Count), `TopUploaders` (UserName, Count, top 10), `AccessByDocument` (Title, Previews, Downloads, Total, top 20), `AccessByDay` (Date, Previews, Downloads).

## IDashboardService (existing — extended)

- `DashboardSummary` gains `DocumentCount` (documents uploaded by the user).

## DI registration (`Program.cs`)

```csharp
builder.Services.AddScoped<IDocumentService, DocumentService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IDocumentReportService, DocumentReportService>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IFileStorageService, LocalFileStorageService>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IMalwareScanner, LocalMalwareScanner>();
```
